name: SVRaster
definition: A real-time, high-fidelity novel-view synthesis system using an explicit, neural-free sparse voxel scene representation. It leverages a custom rasterizer on adaptive sparse voxels without neural networks or 3D Gaussians.
summary: SVRaster is a neural-free, real-time novel-view synthesis framework that renders adaptive sparse voxels using ray direction-dependent Morton ordering to eliminate popping artifacts common in Gaussian splatting.
